primary_sources.meaning: Regular Git index entries encode 0644 or 0755; actual working tree owner/group and other permissions are distinct filesystem facts.
Git compares the executable bit when honoring file mode; this proposal keeps the actual executable class strict.
Archive permission restriction defaults to 0002, with user as a separate option. The current actual Ubuntu causal source remains unproved.
